usageNotes: Returns the ordered list of firewall rules defined at the cluster level — rules that apply across all nodes and VMs unless overridden at a lower scope. Requires the Sys.Audit privilege on the root path (/). Rules are returned in positional order (pos field); the pos value is what you pass to rule-specific endpoints when reading, updating, or deleting a single rule.
tips: The 'pos' field in each returned rule is the 1-based index used by sibling endpoints (get/update/delete a single rule). Rules are evaluated top-down; lower pos = higher priority.
A rule's 'enable' field is an integer flag (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled) — disabled rules remain in the list but are not enforced.
The 'action' field may be ACCEPT, DROP, REJECT, or a security group name — check the type field ('in'/'out'/'group') to distinguish firewall rules from group references.
Cluster-level rules apply globally; node-level and VM/CT-level rules can override or supplement them. Use this endpoint to audit the base policy before troubleshooting connectivity.
